title: Understanding the F1 Score
text: The F1 score is a measure of a test's accuracy. It considers both precision and recall to compute the score. Think about how changing the threshold might affect these two components.

title: Threshold and Predictions
text: Changing the threshold in a classification model can alter which predictions are classified as positive or negative. Consider how this might impact the precision and recall.

hintAnswer: The number of true positives may decrease, and false negatives may increase.
title: Effect of Threshold on F1 Score
text: If the threshold is increased, what happens to the number of true positives and false negatives?
choices: The number of true positives may decrease, and false negatives may increase.
True positives and false negatives remain the same
True positives decrease, false negatives increase
True positives increase, false negatives decrease

hintAnswer: Precision is true positives over true positives plus false positives, and recall is true positives over true positives plus false negatives.
title: Precision and Recall
text: How do precision and recall relate to true positives, false positives, and false negatives?
choices: Precision and Recall are the same
Precision is true positives over true positives plus false positives, and recall is true positives over true positives plus false negatives.
